releaseNotes.zh-Hans: 提供商兼容性映射与官方 ProviderCatalog：新增经审阅的火山引擎 Agent Plan、阿里云 Token Plan 模型与能力条目，并补充阿里云按量服务的图片、视频服务声明。套餐目录只列出已审阅的模型 ID，不声明 /models 列表；目录仍随包分发，经 App 严格校验后由同一签名事务生效。
releaseNotes.en: Provider compatibility mapping plus the official ProviderCatalog: adds reviewed Volcengine Agent Plan and Alibaba Cloud Token Plan models and capabilities, and declares Alibaba pay-as-you-go image/video roles. Plan entries list reviewed model identifiers only and claim no /models listing; the catalog ships in-package and activates through the same signed transaction after strict app-side validation.

privacy.zh-Hans: 本包不包含 API 密钥、令牌或带凭据的地址；凭据只保存在已批准的凭据存储中。
privacy.en: This package contains no API keys, tokens or credential-bearing URLs; credentials live only in approved credential storage.

description.zh-Hans: OpenAI Responses 线协议，支持推理强度与思考控制。
description.en: OpenAI Responses wire protocol with reasoning-effort and thinking controls.

description.zh-Hans: OpenAI Chat Completions 兼容线协议，多数兼容网关使用该格式。
description.en: OpenAI Chat Completions compatible wire protocol used by most compatible gateways.

description.zh-Hans: Anthropic Messages 线协议，支持思考预算与强度字段。
description.en: Anthropic Messages wire protocol with thinking budget and effort fields.

notes.zh-Hans: 套餐网关不提供 /models 候选列表；聊天与图片候选仅来自已审阅目录。本轮不提供套餐视频入口。
notes.en: The plan gateway exposes no /models candidate listing; chat and image candidates come only from the reviewed catalog. No plan video entry is offered in this update.

notes.zh-Hans: Token Plan 使用独立的套餐地址与凭据；聊天、图片和视频候选仅来自已审阅目录，不声明 /models 列表。
notes.en: Token Plan uses its own plan endpoint and credentials; chat, image and video candidates come only from the reviewed catalog and claim no /models listing.

notes.zh-Hans: 仅用于图像生成，使用原生 generateContent 图像契约。
notes.en: Image generation only, using the native generateContent image contract.

catalogNotice.zh-Hans: ProviderCatalog.json 与内置资源一致，包含 models.dev 基线以及经 Floe 审阅的官方套餐与媒体条目；套餐条目只列出已审阅的模型 ID，不声明 /models 列表。目录不含密钥或带凭据的地址，且必须通过应用内严格校验后才会生效。
catalogNotice.en: ProviderCatalog.json matches the bundled resource and contains the models.dev baseline plus reviewed official plan and media entries. Plan entries list reviewed model identifiers only and claim no /models listing. The catalog contains no keys or credential-bearing URLs and only activates after the app-side strict validation gate.
